claims: Transfuse packed red blood cells for severe anemia (hemoglobin 6.8-7.1 g/dL) with blood transfusion consent documented.
Monitor arterial blood pressure closely and support with vasopressor (phenylephrine infusion) for hypotension (MAP 59-67 mmHg).
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate FiO2 to maintain adequate oxygenation (PaO2 141-471 mmHg, SpO2 96-98%).
Monitor and manage temporary pacemaker settings (ventricular rate 52 bpm) with continuous ECG monitoring.
Recheck hemoglobin and hematocrit to assess response to transfusion and ongoing anemia.
Monitor lactate trend (1.3-3.1 mmol/L) to assess tissue perfusion and shock resolution.
Replete electrolytes as needed, including monitoring potassium (3.8-4.3 mEq/L), magnesium (2.6 mg/dL), and phosphate (3.8 mg/dL).
Maintain glycemic control with insulin infusion and monitor blood glucose (75-129 mg/dL).
Provide stress ulcer prophylaxis (ranitidine) and DVT prophylaxis as indicated.
Continue pulmonary hygiene with incentive spirometry, cough/deep breathing exercises, and subglottic suctioning.
